installer-gui-script.title: LanVid Studio + Grid L2 + SDK v2.6.0

choice.title: LanVid Studio, Core SDK & DSP CLI
choice.description: LanVid Studio.app (when bundled), Universal liblanvid_core.dylib & lanvid_dsp_server (arm64 NEON + x86_64 AVX2), LanVidCore.xcframework, C/C++ headers, CMake & pkg-config packages.

choice.title: LanVid Grid L2 (ChmodBPF) + DSP Server Auto-Start + OBS & Firewall
choice.description: Installs LaunchDaemons for rootless Layer 2 Ethernet (/dev/bpf* via access_bpf group) and auto-starting 256ch LanVid Grid DSP Server, configures macOS Application Firewall, and auto-installs obs-lanvid plugin when OBS Studio is present.

choice.title: Virtual Audio Device «LanVid Virtual 64ch»
choice.description: CoreAudio HAL plug-in (64 In / 64 Out, Float32, 48/96 kHz) installed to /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/HAL. Appears in Audio MIDI Setup, Logic Pro, REAPER and OBS; streams through LanVid Studio. Restarts coreaudiod.

choice.title: Swift Package LanVidKit
choice.description: Idiomatic Swift 5.9+ async/await wrapper (LanVidSender, LanVidReceiver, LanVidDiscovery, MetalVideoView) for iOS 15+ and macOS 12+.

choice.title: Python Bindings, OBS Plugin Bundle & Examples
choice.description: Zero-dependency Python ctypes/NumPy wrapper (lanvid_sdk.py), obs-lanvid plugin resources, SwiftUI iOSCameraSender & MacReceiverMetal examples, and CMake C++17 client.
